parts:
Hi all, 

I'm building a commercial risk engine in stan, and the firm I'm working for is planning on rolling it out in the next month. Unfortunately, I'm the only stan user on the team, and we'd all feel more comfortable if the code was checked by someone else. This is not trivial, since the stan models themselves are being automatically generated with some kludged-together templating from within R. 

If there are any keen stan users who'd be open to the work--it's probably around 5-10 hrs worth--then please drop me a line at ja...@lendable.io

Cheers, 
Jimmy Savage
